@tthvo hey, sorry for the delay. I broke up the change into 2 commits, one that updates go.mod and 7 import statements, and one with all the vendor changes.

I'm happy to create a Jira as well if you can link me to the appropriate project/component.

Context for this change, is in the blog post I linked to. Development of containers/images dependency moved from one github repo into another. In the process the import paths also changed. This project is still using the old imports. Because of that, it could look like you're on the most recent version of the dependency when in reality development has moved on.

This PR switches the project over to the new import path so you can at least tell how far ahead the dependency is and it would (in theory) make bumping versions for CVEs easier.

> I'm happy to create a Jira as well if you can link me to the appropriate project/component.

Thanks, you can create a card in project [CORS](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/CORS) or [OCPBUGS](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/OCPBUGS) (if this needs backporting later).

/cc @andfasano
